description.value:
At 1st level and every four red mage levels thereafter, a red mage increases his power with his spells. At each such opportunity, he can choose from the following (maximum 2 per):

  • Extra Quick Casts: Grants an additional use of Quick Cast per day. (Cannot be obtained until 5th level.)
  • Quick Mind: Grants an additional swift or immediate action per round usable with red mage class features or spells. Does not increase the normal limit of one swift cast spell per round.
  • Ruby Knowledge Mastery: Increases the Intelligence/Wisdom score for Ruby Knowledge as if it were two points higher. (Cannot be obtained until 5th level.)
  • Spell Combat Expertise: Lowers the attack penalty of spell combat by 1.
